root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `parse_double()` lets a decimal-only literal continue into `compute_float_64()`, the implicit decimal exponent must satisfy `exponent >= simdjson::internal::smallest_power` so the power-of-five table lookup stays in range.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the crashing path, the decimal-only literal has 343 fractional digits and no explicit exponent suffix, so the vulnerable code skips the only exponent-range update and reaches float assembly with `exponent == -343`, one below `simdjson::internal::smallest_power`. The fixed program performs the same range check for decimal-only numbers before `compute_float_64()`.

nodes.state: Immediately before the failing table read, `index` already exceeds the last valid first-lookup slot derived from `simdjson::internal::largest_power`, so `power_of_five_128[index]` dereferences beyond the precomputed table.

edges.relation: The implicit exponent derived in `parse_double()` is passed unchanged as `power` into `compute_float_64()` and is still the out-of-range value that drives the failing power-of-five table lookup.
